pr_title: Add support for removing environment secrets
pr_body:
Building on top of #3270 (list env secrets) and #3769 (set env secrets), this adds support for removing environment secrets.

Fixes #3265

comments:
## Adding Secrets to GitHub environments

Would it also be possible to create secrets for GH environments? My hope was to run this from CLI

```
gh secret set ENV_KEY -e "DEV-ENV"  -b"${ENV_VALUE}"
```
Thank you!

I would think we would want to continue implementing the rest of the environment secrets functionality. This would also include set and remove. It shouldn't be too hard to implement in my opinion. @mislav, thoughts?
